summary: alf.io is a Java/Spring event-ticketing platform (sales, check-in, invoicing). Users/admin manage organizations and events; attendees reserve tickets via reservations with payments; tickets are checked in; subscriptions, polls, groups, extensions and config round out the feature set. It is a full CRUD app over a Postgres database: events, ticket categories, special prices, promo codes, reservations, tickets, transactions, billing documents, waiting-queue subscribers, groups, subscriptions, polls and extension-support rows are all persisted and read back.
